messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] PAGER: service=text-gen-prod severity=sev2 error_rate=5.7% across region-us-east. Routing to primary oncall @alex. Link: https://incidents.redwood/internal/1835012345

alex: Got it — I'm on. Quick status check: are we seeing user-facing 5xxs or client-side timeouts?

alex: I can take primary until 04:30 UTC. If this persists past that, anne you ok to be secondary for the next shift? @anne

mira: @alex thanks. FYI i've bumped the visibility to CSMs — Suspect recent model rollout might be amplifying cost causing 503s when queue backs up. No P0 yet, customers seeing intermittent failures.

jonathan: +1 on rollout being suspect. Metrics show a 2x increase in avg response tokens per request since 03:50 UTC.

sam: Coverage note — i have a calendar conflict at 04:00–05:00 UTC so won't be available for the 04:30 handoff. anne said she'd be reachable.

alex: Ok switching to mitigation mode. Steps: 1) enable temporary SLO threshold suppression for alert group text-gen-503 spanning 30m; 2) scale up dedicated pool by +2 gpus (if autoscale doesn't kick); 3) roll back last model variant if scaling doesn't help. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/text-gen-ops (see section "SLO suppress & scale").

mira: Please post the exact suppression window and who signs off. For audit we need justification and link to post-incident doc.

alex: Proposed suppression command (will run in infra console):

```
# temporarily mute alert rule for 30m
POST /alerts/mute
{
  "rule": "text-gen-503-rate",
  "duration": "30m",
  "reason": "temporary noise during scaling + suspected rollout regression",
  "initiated_by": "alex"
}
```

alex: Running now. Also triggering additional logs: trace_id=tx-1835012345-ctx for correlation.

incident-bot: Alert rule text-gen-503-rate muted by alex for 30m (expiry 1835014145). Audit id: mute-9091.

mira: Approved. Please add a line in the postmortem template referencing the temporary SLO suppression and include threshold values before/after.

jonathan: Scaling attempt to +2 gpus started. ETA 2m. If that doesn't bucket down latency, next is immediate rollback of last model-version (v2026.03.10).

sam: Noted coverage gap 04:00–05:00UTC. Anne confirmed she'll be on standby for handoff at 04:30. @anne can you confirm?

anne: Confirmed. i'll be primary at 04:30 if alex still needs a handoff. I'll monitor the muted alert and watch queue depth.

alex: Customer impact: roughly 12 customers saw 5–30s errors, support tickets created for 4 customers flagged as high priority. I updated the internal status page: https://status.redwood.internal/incidents/1835012345

mira: Good. After scaling completes, let's keep the suppression until we validate rollback/patch. If latency remains high after 30m, we extend to 60m with extra notes and exec ping.

jonathan: Scaling finished; GPU pool back to target. Error rate trending down to 1.2% over last 3m.

alex: Rolling signals: latency 95p dropped from 780ms -> 240ms, error rate 5.7% -> 1.1%. I'll unmute early if stable.

incident-bot: mute text-gen-503-rate expired (or was cleared early) at 1835013900.

alex: Unmuted early at 1835013900 after stability check. Leaving a note in runbook and creating post-incident checklist. Postmortem owner: @mira.

mira: Thanks team. Action items: (1) jonathan to investigate token count spike root cause; (2) eng-runtime to add smoother autoscale preflight for model variants; (3) ops to add a small playbook paragraph about when to use SLO suppression vs mitigation. I'll own the postmortem and customer comms.

jonathan: Adding preliminary perf trace links to the postmortem right now.

sam: Closing loop on coverage: anne will be primary for the 04:30 handoff if needed. I'll update rotation notes.

alex: tl;dr: temporary SLO suppression approved and applied, scaling reduced errors, coverage gap noted and patched by anne, postmortem assigned. Thanks. :thumbsup:
